title: National Beverage Corp. Celebrates America With Special Cash Dividend and Reports FY 2026 Results
summary: FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 1, 2026-- National Beverage Corp. (NASDAQ: FIZZ) today announced its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend of $3.25 per share to shareholders of record on July 13, 2026 to be paid on or before July 30, 2026.
body_markdown: FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 1, 2026-- National Beverage Corp. (NASDAQ: FIZZ) today announced its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend of $3.25 per share to shareholders of record on July 13, 2026 to be paid on or before July 30, 2026.
